children.value: > Fact From Story: In a sudden late announcement, OpenAI revealed that it and Altman “have reached an agreement in principle” for him to return as the company’s CEO.
> > Fact From Story: Sam Altman was fired as CEO of AI startup OpenAI
> > > Fact From Story: OpenAI has appointed Emmett Shear, the co-founder of video streaming site Twitch, as interim CEO — replacing Murati.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge:  A company will seek a permanent CEO after an interim CEO has been appointed.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A person must have been fired to later be rehired.
> Commonsense Knowledge: To be rehired, one must have been fired at some point.
